name: Enc and the Flying Machine
source:
Follow the mushroom Enc on her little quest to help her new found friend Torze in making a flying machine, while they discuss about war and how to grow plants that become engines! Also help her in cheer up her old friend Sinal who out of nowhere got kinda down in the dumps for some reason!

[From [url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/enc-and-the-flying-machine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟隨蘑菇女孩恩，幫助新朋友託澤製造飛行器；她們會討論戰爭，以及如何種植能夠成為引擎的植物！也幫她為老朋友西納爾打打氣——西納爾不知為何突然陷入低落！

[來源：[url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/enc-and-the-flying-machine]itch.io[/url]]
